page.notes: Hab.1:11 is printed "Hab.r:rr."; the first letter is read as r, probably 1 [?]. The text shows "fue-rit?" with a line-end hyphen and a question mark, copied as printed. The word "lum" at the top is a fragment and is kept as printed. The Greek is copied from the scan and not checked against a source; its accents may be imperfect. The catchword "justitia" and the signature "B" are kept at the foot, outside the text.
